Original reproducer: I brought redteam-RT-01-p4-01-wythoff-edges-rounded.test.ts in from worktree-agent-ac20bce8854056aaa as an untracked file (git show) and ran it with vitest in packages/engine. It passes: the call now throws EngineOverflow, which is the reproducer's accepted branch. The named search harness redteam-RT-01-diff-wythoff-big.test.ts (python3 bridge) still exits 1, but all 3 of its edge disagreements are now 'engine=ERR EngineOverflow': A3 named SafeInt, which the harness itself labels as the documented answer, plus G2 swapped Big and B3 relabelled Big. At b9b8504 the last two were rounded values (13510798882111492; -9007199254740996). Regression tests: wythoff-edges-beyond-2-53.test.ts, 2 tests each marked '// regression: P4-RT-01-01', both pass. Scratch revert: I put packages/engine/src/wythoff.ts back to 967118d, which undoes the whole 17-line diff (the EngineOverflow import, SAFE_MAX, and the checked toNumber, so toNumber is again Number(arith.toBig(x))). The result was 5 failed | 3 passed. Both regression tests failed ('expected [ …(6) ] to deeply equal [ …(6) ]' and 'expected function to throw an error, but it didn't'), and so did both original reproducers. Then restored with git checkout. Boundary sweep (my own oracle script around reference/lie_games.py wythoff_edges plus a scratch vitest file): 123 cases on G2 swapped, B3 relabelled, A3 middle first, C3 relabelled, A4 relabelled, D4 centre first (all Big), with B2 and C2 (SafeInt) as controls. Rings were the largest multiple of each pattern with max entry <= 2^53-1 and the next multiple, plus rings found by binary search whose largest entry is exactly 2^53-1 or exactly 2^53, plus random rings near the boundary. Big: 45 of 45 cases with max <= 2^53-1 were exact and equal to the oracle edge set digit for digit, 23 of them with max exactly 9007199254740991. 47 of 47 cases above threw EngineOverflow, 23 of them with max exactly 2^53. 3 cases whose ring itself was 2^53 got the ring-check RangeError. SafeInt: every case above the boundary threw EngineOverflow. 14 cases below it also threw, because SafeInt checks intermediate products; this predates the fix and is recorded in the fragment.

Original reproducer: redteam-RT-01-p4-02-entries-beyond-2-53.test.ts from worktree-agent-ac20bce8854056aaa, untracked. Together with classify-entries-beyond-2-53.test.ts (11 tests marked '// regression: P4-RT-01-02'): 2 files, 23 tests passed. Scratch revert: packages/engine/src/classify.ts back to 967118d. That undoes the 9-line diff: the R matrix of rat(BigInt(x)) in symmetrizer, its use in the walk and in the pair check, and rat(BigInt(x)) in gram. Result 18 failed | 5 passed. The original failed 7 of 9, exactly as the finding states. The regression file failed 11 with 'RangeError: the numerator -9007199254740992 is not a safe integer' (-18014398509481984 on the 3-node board) and coxeterNumber gave 'expected error to be instance of NotFiniteType'. Restored after. Oracle comparison (my own script cls_cases.py plus a scratch vitest file): 36 random boards with entries beyond 2^53 that a double holds exactly, up to 2^62 times a 20-bit factor. They include 2-node boards; paths of 3 to 5 and stars of 4 (balanced); balanced and unbalanced triangles; boards in pieces with A1, A2, B2, G2, A1~ and A2~ pieces or two big pieces; and 3 one-way boards. In total 33 gcm, 29 balanced, 11 in pieces, none symmetric, so the new bigint path is exercised rather than the shortcut. symmetrizer, gram, classify (records including bourbaki_order and marks/comarks), smallestNonfiniteSubboard, cartanClass (connected) and formValue (x,y and x,x) all equal lie_games.py: 349 of 349 checks. With classify.ts reverted the same file had 329 failures (RangeError). SPEC 5.6 guards on the same boards: every function in the last row of the table (weylOrder, weylDimension, orbitSize, longestWord, minusW0, minusculeNodes, highestRoot, highestShortRoot, coxeterNumber, wavePlay, countCompleteGames, legalLayers, coroot, separatingRoots, fold, averagedRootsType, averagedSimpleCartan, wythoffFaceTypes, wythoffFVector, wythoffEdges, choleskyBasis, euclideanBasis, coxeterPlanePoints, coxeterPlaneRings, coxeterWord, applyWordFloat) and affineExtension threw NotFiniteType on all 33 gcm boards and NeedsTwoWayRoads on all 3 one-way boards. marks, comarks and level threw NotAffine and NeedsTwoWayRoads respectively. cartanClass, identify and identifyAffine threw NeedsConnectedBoard on the 9 gcm boards in pieces. On one-way boards, cartanClass and isRootPopulation threw NeedsTwoWayRoads, and identify, identifyAffine, smallestNonfiniteSubboard, spectralRadius, symmetrizer and gram returned null. isRootPopulation, spectralRadius and classify work on gcm boards. Not one RangeError.

The fixer marked this needs-decision, and I agree it needs the owner. The fixer wrote the bigint case (seeds times 2^60, the same 2000 positions, 25 ms) but did not commit it: it measured 21.6 to 40.5 ms on this machine, including 24.29 to 31.84 ms at load ~2. A threshold is fixed by SPEC 7.6 and is not the fixer's to change. Whether 'in Big arithmetic' names the board (E-2) or the computation (5.5, bench_orbit.mjs) is a reading of the spec. The record of what the benchmark measures, the options (a), (b) and (c), and the exact edit are in decisions/RT-FIX-P4-engine.md. My numbers: I added the edit as written there to packages/engine/test/bench/orbit.bench.ts as a scratch, uncommitted change and ran `vitest run --config test/bench/vitest.config.ts orbit.bench` in packages/engine. I waited for quiet with a loop watching /proc/loadavg; the lowest one-minute load I found was 1.72 to 2.12. At load 2.12 (5-min 5.55) the bigint case medians were 22.23, 35.37 and 37.04 ms, against 14.34, 13.73 and 9.87 ms for the existing case. At load 1.72 to 1.78 (5-min 5.2) they were 24.03, 38.15 and 21.70 ms, against 15.16, 11.33 and 8.85 ms. Earlier, at load 3.26: 21.66, 26.81 and 21.60 ms. The results are bimodal, about 21 to 24 ms or about 35 to 38 ms; in 9 runs, 5 passed and 4 failed against 25 ms. With the lens mutant F9-generic-slow applied, the bigint case measured 318.52 ms and failed while the existing case passed at 19.30 ms, so the case does catch F9. Afterwards orbit.bench.ts was restored with git checkout, search.ts was reverted with patch -R, and git status was clean.
